verdict.rationale: Fellow documents automatic "suggested AI action items" for every meeting. Action items carry assignees and due dates, and they can be listed and filtered by owner (assigned_to_me / assigned_to_others), marked complete or archived, and queried through the MCP server ("What were my action items this week?"). The evidence for tracking comes mainly from the API and MCP docs rather than an in-app tracker. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the AI assigns owners from the conversation (items are only "suggested"), documentation of an in-app consolidated action-item tracking view, independent or hands-on corroboration.
